events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, known as the frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Vibe
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! What's your favourite Liam Gallagher tune, whether it's from Oasis, Beady Eye, or his solo career?

events.title: Imagine album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, following its US release on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates today. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, making it available for purchase on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you put '1,000 songs in your pocket'? The original iPod was unveiled 25 years ago. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Bond's Best
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite 007 moment or track?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary musician, singer, and songwriter who co-founded The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: The one and only John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today! Which of his iconic roles or sketches makes you laugh the most?

events.title: The White Album released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Tracks
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A double album packed with classics and experimental tracks. Which one is always on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45 due to complications from AIDS.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who we lost on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that showcased their incredible growth and creativity. What's the track you always go back to?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy Endures
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who we lost in 1980. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What impact did he have on you?
